dedupe_keys.name: emplacements reserves au benefice du departement pour voirie et equipements publics

description: Emplacements réservés au bénéfice du Département pour voirie et équipements publics is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Département des Hauts-de-Seine. Places reserved for the benefit of the Department for roads and public facilities Delimitation of areas subject to special rules called "reserved spaces" (Article L151-41 of the Urban Planning Code) subject to a special status and distinguished by their purpose and scope. Coverage: Département des Hauts-de-Seine. The portal shows the English title as "Places reserved for the benefit of the Department for roads and public facilities" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Département des Hauts-de-Seine. Its keywords include urbanisme, emplacements-reserves, routes-departementales, plans-locaux-durbanisme, plu. The listing shows 4 download or service links in ZIP, JSON, CSV. The listing shows 2026-02-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
